map.输入培训前后能力评分和参训情况，按柯氏四级评估模型评价培训效果: Enter pre- and post-training competency scores and participation details to evaluate training effectiveness with the four-level Kirkpatrick model.
map.📖 查看「培训（需求/计划/效果）评估 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Training (Needs / Plan / Effectiveness) Assessment" guide
map.培训评估 = 需求/效果加权: Training assessment = weighted needs and effectiveness
map.📚 深度解析：培训需求、计划与效果评估: 📚 Deep dive: training needs, planning and effectiveness assessment
map.按缺口分析定需求，再评估计划可行性与训后效果。: Set needs from a gap analysis, then assess plan feasibility and post-training effectiveness.
map.柯氏四级（反应/学习/行为/结果）打分合成培训: Score the Kirkpatrick four levels (reaction / learning / behaviour / results) and combine them into training
map.年度培训规划排序，优先投入高杠杆主题。: Rank annual training plans and invest first in high-leverage topics.
map.需求紧迫 5.5、计划可行 7.8、训后效果 8.5，按权重合成 → 工具给出综: Urgency of need 5.5, plan feasibility 7.8, post-training effectiveness 8.5; weighting them together gives the tool a composite 7.4, which clears the threshold for approval.
map.某课训后 3 月行为改变率仅 20%，低于目标 50%，建议改实操占比。: A course shows only a 20% behaviour change rate three months after training, below the 50% target, so increase the proportion of hands-on practice.
map.结合训后测评、上级评分与业务指标（如差错率下降）多源印证，单看满意度易虚高。: Combine post-training assessments, manager ratings and business metrics (such as a drop in error rate) across multiple sources; satisfaction scores alone tend to look inflated.
map.需求从哪来？: Where do training needs come from?
map.绩效差距、胜任力模型缺口与员工调研三方交汇处最该优先排课。: The intersection of performance gaps, competency model gaps and employee surveys should drive course prioritisation.
map.柯氏四级评估：L1反应(满意度)、L2学习(测试)、L3行为(能力变化)、L4结: Kirkpatrick four levels: L1 reaction (satisfaction), L2 learning (test), L3 behaviour (capability change), L4 results (business impact)
map.培训前后能力对比是最直观的效果指标: Pre- and post-training competency comparison is the most intuitive effectiveness metric
map.满意度调查应在培训结束后立即进行: The satisfaction survey should be run immediately after the session ends
map.行为层评估建议在培训后1-3个月进行跟踪: Behaviour-level assessment is recommended as a follow-up 1-3 months after training
map.结果层评估需结合KPI变化，周期较长: Results-level assessment must be combined with KPI changes and takes a longer cycle
map.培训效果评估工具，基于柯氏四级评估模型，从满意度、知识测试、能力提升三个维度评价: Training effectiveness assessment tool based on the Kirkpatrick four-level model, evaluating training effectiveness across satisfaction, knowledge testing and capability improvement.
